Will you owe the IRS a surprise tax bill?

When you work for yourself, no one takes tax out of your money for you. You have to pay it yourself. See what you may owe — before it becomes a surprise.

Plan for this the smart way — book a free call → A 20‑minute call. No cost, no pressure.

What new owners miss

In plain words, so nothing catches you off guard.

  • No one takes tax out for you. At a job, your employer sends tax to the IRS from each paycheck. When you work for yourself, that is now your job.
  • The IRS wants it four times a year. Not once. If you wait until tax time, the bill can be large — and there can be a penalty for paying late.
  • You can plan for it. When you set money aside as you earn, tax time is calm — no surprise, no scramble. That is what we set up for you.

Hi, I'm Julia.

Founder, JK Accounting GroupEnglish · Russian · Ukrainian

A surprise tax bill is one of the most stressful things for a new business owner in the US — especially if the tax system where you come from worked differently.

We plan your tax through the year, so nothing is a shock in April. This tool gives you a quick idea; I would be glad to build the real plan with you.

Never be surprised by a tax bill again.

Send us your details and we will help you plan — in English, Russian, or Ukrainian. Or book a free 20‑minute call.

  • Know what to set aside, every month.
  • Pay the IRS on time and avoid penalties.
  • A real person who speaks your language.

Prefer WhatsApp? Message us here

Optional. We will use whatever is easiest for you.

Or book a call now
